verdict.rationale: ReelMimic uses an existing video only as a reference to break down and then generate a new 2D video. Its revision features (chat requests, timestamped comments on the finished output) are general feedback loops for regenerating work. They are not documented element-level replacement or restyling inside an existing video that leaves the rest of the frame untouched. These features count as adjacent, not as the capability itself.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
